item_name: Rothco Black Open Face Web Belt Buckle
item_short_desc: Complete your belt with Rothco’s Open Face Web Belt Buckle, designed to pair seamlessly with our web belt webbing. Built for durability and style, this buckle offers a secure and adjustable fit, making it ideal for tactical use, workwear, or everyday fashion. Whether you're replacing an old buckle or customizing a new belt, this sleek and functional buckle is the perfect choice.
